rule_en: Third conditional = unreal past: If + past perfect, would have + past participle. It imagines a different past: If I had tested it, it wouldn't have crashed.
rule_bn: অতীত নিয়ে কল্পনা → If + past perfect, would have + past participle। যা ঘটেনি: If I had tested it, it wouldn't have crashed.

sessions.title: Spot the Error
sessions.instruction_en: Tap the wrong word, then choose the fix.

items.prompt_en: If you would have tested the flow, it wouldn't have crashed
items.explain_en: No 'would' in the if-clause: If + past perfect.

items.prompt_en: If we had froze the scope, we would have shipped on time
items.explain_en: Past perfect = had + past participle: frozen.

items.prompt_en: She would have catch the bug if she had reviewed the diff
items.explain_en: would have + past participle: caught.

items.prompt_en: If the demo had worked, the client would has signed the deal
items.explain_en: 'would have' never changes to 'would has'.

items.prompt_en: If I knew about the outage, I would have cancelled the demo
items.explain_en: An unreal past condition → past perfect, not past simple.

items.prompt_en: If they hadn't skip the retro, they would have caught the pattern
items.explain_en: had/hadn't + past participle: skipped.

items.prompt_en: We would have win the hackathon if the wifi hadn't died
items.explain_en: Past participle after 'would have': won.

items.prompt_en: If you had asked me, I would helped you with the migration
items.explain_en: The result needs the full chain: would + have + past participle.

items.prompt_en: If the backup had ran last night, we wouldn't have lost data
items.explain_en: had + past participle: run.

items.prompt_en: If she has joined the call, she would have heard the decision
items.explain_en: Third conditional if-clause: had + past participle, not 'has'.

sessions.title: Choose & Fill
sessions.instruction_en: Tap the correct option or chip.

items.prompt_en: If we ___ the logs earlier, we would have found the leak.
items.explain_en: Unreal past → if + past perfect.

items.prompt_en: She would have taken the offer if the role ___ remote.
items.explain_en: Past unreal 'be' → had been.

items.prompt_en: If you had told me sooner, I ___ the meeting.
items.explain_en: A past result → would have + past participle.

items.prompt_en: We ___ the data if the script had asked for confirmation.
items.explain_en: An unreal past result → wouldn't have + past participle.

items.prompt_en: If the recruiter ___ , I might have missed this job entirely.
items.explain_en: A negative unreal past → hadn't + past participle.

items.prompt_en: If I had slept more, I ___ that silly mistake.
items.explain_en: would(n't) have + past participle for the unreal past result.

items.prompt_en: The release would have failed if QA ___ the edge case.
items.explain_en: If-clause: had/hadn't + past participle.

items.prompt_en: If we ___ earlier, we could have fixed it before the demo.
items.explain_en: Third conditional if-clause: past perfect.

items.prompt_en: She ___ the bug if she had run the full test suite.
items.explain_en: Past participle after 'would have': seen.

items.prompt_en: If the meeting ___ shorter, I would have stayed until the end.
items.explain_en: Unreal past 'be' → had been.

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
items.answer: If I had saved my work , the crash wouldn't have mattered .

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.

items.prompt_en: Build the sentence.
